name: Icegram AI Content Engine – SEO & AEO Blog Generator
author: Icegram

sections.description:
Most AI blog tools generate content.

This plugin generates content that performs.

AI Blog Generator helps you create blog posts that are:
– Optimized for SEO (Google rankings)
– Structured for AEO (AI answers like ChatGPT, Google SGE)
– Designed for conversion (not just traffic)

All directly inside your WordPress dashboard.

🚀 Why this plugin stands out

Unlike generic AI writers, this plugin follows a proven content SOP (Standard Operating Process) used by growth teams.

Each blog is automatically structured with:

✔ Direct answer intro (AEO-ready)
✔ Skimmable sections (better engagement)
✔ Comparison blocks (high-intent traffic)
✔ Conversion-focused conclusion
✔ FAQ section (rich snippet ready)

👉 You don’t just get content — you get content that ranks, gets picked by AI, and converts.

✍️ What you can create

  • Listicles (Best tools, Top X)
  • Comparison blogs
  • How-to guides
  • Product-led content
  • SEO landing blogs

⚡ Key Features

  • One-click blog generation inside WP admin
  • AEO-first structured content output
  • SEO-friendly formatting (headings, bullets, FAQs)
  • Conversion-focused writing style
  • “Save as Draft” option
  • Lightweight and fast (no external UI clutter)

🧠 Built on a Proven Content SOP

This plugin follows a structured writing framework:

  1. Answer-first introduction (AEO)
  2. Quick summary / list (featured snippet ready)
  3. Topic explanation (SEO depth)
  4. Decision guidance (user intent)
  5. Comparison / tools section
  6. Summary table
  7. Conversion-driven conclusion
  8. FAQ (schema-ready)

👉 This ensures every blog is:
– Discoverable
– Understandable
– Actionable

🎯 Who is this for?

  • Bloggers who want more traffic
  • WooCommerce store owners
  • SaaS founders doing content marketing
  • Agencies scaling content production
  • Anyone tired of rewriting AI content manually

⚙️ How it works

  1. Enter your topic, keyword, and audience
  2. Click “Generate”
  3. Get a fully structured blog
  4. Edit (optional)
  5. Save as draft or publish

🔐 Privacy & Data

This plugin sends your input (topic, keywords) to an external AI API to generate content.

  • No data is stored on our servers
  • You control your API key
  • No tracking or hidden data collection

External services

This plugin connects to the OpenAI API to generate AI-powered blog content, article ideas, titles, summaries, and related text content.

It sends the following data to the OpenAI API service when a user generates content:

User-provided prompts
Content instructions
Selected generation settings

This data is sent only when the user explicitly requests AI content generation from the plugin interface.

The service is provided by OpenAI.

Terms of Service:
https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use/

Privacy Policy:
https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/

Development

This plugin uses React and @wordpress/scripts for asset compilation.

Source files are available in the /src directory.

Build commands:

npm install
npm run build
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Go to AI Blog Generator → Settings
  4. Add your API key
  5. Start generating blogs
sections.faq:
Do I need an API key?

Yes. You need an OpenAI-compatible API key to generate content.

Will this content rank on Google?

The plugin follows SEO and AEO best practices, but rankings depend on your niche, competition, and consistency.

Can I publish content directly?

You can generate and save as draft. Review before publishing is recommended.

Is this better than ChatGPT?

This plugin applies a structured SOP automatically, so you don’t need to prompt-engineer every time.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes, especially for product-led and comparison blogs.
